title: Ominous Mod
description: raid captains now drop ominous bottles
body: This mod is meant to make raid farms fully AFK-able on 1.21.11 and newer. Works in single player, client side, and server side. This mod makes raid captains now drop ominous bottles. This is aimed to help make raid farms fully afk-able in newer versions. REQUIRES FABRIC API. THIS MOD CANNOT BE USED SEPERATELY DISTRIBUTED UNLESS OTHERWISE SPECIFIED BY OWNER.
